keys.motion_arc_root_note: same contact graph; authored platform deceleration introduces +X shear demand; torso counterleans -X while feet remain planted

keys.causal_role: transient information spike / peak inertial response

keys.name: BRAKE_PEAK

keys.causal_role: sustained load-bearing consequence / dwell on resistance

keys.name: BRAKE_HOLD

keys.causal_role: release event / load vector changes again without contact topology change

keys.name: RECOVER

keys.causal_role: stable end state / expose restored phase and reuse

keys.name: CRUISE_RESTORED

source.name: Dr Robuttnik (Elevator)
observed: TSR currently identifies the source as Dr Robuttnik (Elevator), Sunky's Schoolhouse, PC / Computer, a 4480x360 PNG.
The owning PoseLab v1.7 exact-custody record establishes the full source as a 32,657-byte RGBA PNG with SHA-256 1304b1cacd772e783e9d000691ba22b39f254d7964b53a1e552e3c881facefca.
That full-sheet custody record inspected the whole 4480x360 sheet as seven equal 640-pixel cells.
Across the inspected cells, opaque material reaches a common lower sheet boundary while local occupied extent changes.
The source is a static sheet; spatial cell order is not treated as playback chronology.
source.rights_note: Copyrighted source sheet is analysis evidence only. No source pixels, palette, contours, layout, frame drawings, tracing, redistribution, or close imitation are stored or rendered. The specimen preserves only abstract timing/reference-frame/support-load principles in an independently authored ASCII rig.

sheet.inspection_note: Current run re-read the owning PoseLab v1.7 exact whole-sheet custody/inspection record and refreshed the TSR source-page metadata. Historical pass is evidence only; this repo SPA is the V2 product.

thesis: Parent translation does not spend passenger-local timing bandwidth. With unchanged bilateral contact, only a material authored support-load change earns a new local key.
